content.text: Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade | City of Norfolk, Virginia - Official Website Skip To Main ContentLoading Skip to Main Content Home Sign up for City Updates Contact Us /QuickLinks.aspx Search HomeA to ZOcean View St. Patrick's Day Parade Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade The 59th Annual Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade is Saturday, March 14, 2026. Sponsored and presented by Norfolk Parade, Incorporated, the Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade is a Norfolk tradition! Whether you're a parade pro or a first-timer, it's always good luck to plan ahead. Road Closures Parade Route Parking Safety For Extra Luck Road Closures Norfolk Police will close Granby St. from Bayview Blvd. to Bay Ave. starting at 7:30 a.m. on Saturday, March 14.The rest of the parade route will be closed by 9:00 a.m.All streets will re-open by noon except First View St. which will remain closed until 1:30 p.m., and Government Ave. which will remain closed from First View St. to Hickory St. until 4:30 p.m. Parade Route The parade steps off at 10 a.m. at Northside Middle School (8720 Granby Street).From that point, it travels north on Granby Street, turns left at A View Avenue, turns left on First View Street, and ends at the intersection of First View and Government Avenue.The parade route is approximately 1.5 miles Click here Version OptionsOcean View St. Patrick's Day ParadeHeadline Version Options Ocean View St. Patrick's Day Parade Headline for a map of the full parade route. Parking Please be mindful of "No Parking" signage as well as "No Parking on Grass" signage. Additionally, areas marked off by police tape are no parking zones. As a tradition, cars may park on NON-CURBED medians along the route that are not marked off by police tape or no parking signage. Parking on medians is not permitted prior to 5 p.m. on Thursday, March 12, 2026.Parking on the uncurbed median will be allowed beginning Thursday at 5 pm.Norfolk Police will tow cars parked illegally along the parade route.On-street parking is available on most of the adjacent blocks along the parade route.Off-street parking is available at Sarah Constant Beach Park (300 W. Ocean View Ave.), Ocean View Beach Park (100 W. Ocean View Ave.), Ocean View Elementary School (350 W. Government Ave.) and Mary D. Pretlow Anchor Branch Library (111 W. Ocean View Ave). Safety Please be mindful of the increased pedestrian, bicycle and motor traffic along and adjacent to the parade route. Be EXTRA cautious of children and pets. Expect crowds and give yourself plenty of time to park safely. Don't forget to lock your vehicles and leave valuables at home. Don't push your luck by drinking and driving! Be sure to call a taxi or ride share to get you home safely. It's bad luck to leave parade trash behind! Please pack a trash bag with your parade gear or look out for Keep Norfolk Beautiful volunteers who will be handing them out during the parade. Please be sure to bag your trash and dispose of it properly and don't forget to recycle your bottles and cans. PRO TIP: You can place your bagged and tied trash bags next to any of our "PARADE RIGHT OV" signs and our Waste Management crews will collect and dispose properly.
